description: Header file defining the FakeVideoEncodeAccelerator class, a mock implementation of a video encoding accelerator used for testing or simulation within the media namespace.

classes.name: FakeVideoEncodeAccelerator
classes.description: A mock implementation of VideoEncodeAccelerator for testing purposes, providing methods to simulate encoding behavior and manage internal state.

classes.name: FrameToEncode
classes.description: Structure representing a video frame to be encoded, including the frame data and keyframe flag.

methods.description: Initializes the encoder with configuration, client, and optional media log.

methods.description: Provides an output buffer for encoded data.

methods.description: Indicates if GPU frame resize is supported.
